notes.title: Update - Game controller auto-select option
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Game controller auto-select option. When ON, the game controller will be automatically linked to joystick. The option is set ON by default. User is still responsible for attaching the joystick cable though.
[*] Fix: sending correct device id for emulator failed sometimes when attaching joystick. (Especially when more than one Game controllers where attached)
[*] Small performance fix for Direct Input device handling
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] Monitor Screen Shader update
[*] Fix for Monitor screen blur effect
[*] Fix for Monitor screen pixel color overflow
[/list]

notes.title: Update - New monitor screen shader
notes.content:
[list]
[*] New Shader for rendering monitor screen output
[*] Fix for emulator output rendering logic. (Depending on the hardware, the frequency of screen rendering calls was either too high or too low.)
[/list]

[*] Drag and drop the tape into the cassette unit.
[*] Drag and drop the cartridge into the cartridge slot.
[*] A swipe out removes a disk, tape, or cart from a drive, cassette unit, or cartridge slot.

notes.title: Price updates
notes.content:
In general, the base USD price has now been reduced from USD 24.99 to USD 19.99.

Prices have also been re-leveled based on Steam's recommended prices. As a result, price changes are different for different currencies. And in some currencies, prices have even increased.

notes.title: Update - Cassette tape animation
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Cassette tape animates on play/rew/ffwd/rec.
[*] The cassette stops when it has been wound to the end.
[*] The cassette now defaults to the beginning when it's ejected or out of the deck.
  (A technical limitation. The state has to be in sync with the emulator)
[*] Pet cabel artifact fix.
[*] Disabled rest of the simulator view mouse hover sounds.
[*] Fix to restrict simulator view zoom actions while menu is open.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Tape drive counter adjustments
notes.content:
[list]

[/list]

notes.title: Update - Cassette unit feature updates
notes.content:
Cassette unit feature updates.
[list]
[*] VIC-20 C2N cassette recorder got a working counter.
[*] It's now possible to rewind the tape to the beginning.
[*] Updates to counter and counter reset logic.
[*] Record multiple programs after another on the cassette.
[*] Load programs from different locations on the cassette.
[/list]

Note! In case someone loves the tape handling too much, you may notice some funny/missing features.
[list]
[*] The actual tape inside the cassette still lacks the corresponding state/animation.
[*] Cassette can be fast forwarded to infinity.
[*] Computer reboot or cassette switch will reset the tape to the beginning.
[/list]

notes.title: Hot Fix - keyboard mappings
notes.content:
Fixed a serious bug in C-64 keyboard mappings.
Now the symbolic mapping should work as designed with swedish, german and italian keyboard layouts.

Must have been inconvenient to use, thank you for your patience!

e.g. The symbols you type in the PC-keyboard should be displayed on the simulated computer screen.
Assuming that the computer has the symbol. If you find any symbols not working, please report it as a bug.

notes.title: Hot Fix - Emulator Setup
notes.content:
Hot Fix is released.

There was a major issue in emulator setup not accepting the installation path.
Issue is now fixed. Just update The Breadbox if it isn't already up to date.
